data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves opened the year at GBP 910.762m and the technical provisions note records a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 78.241m at 31 December 2023. The movement reflects a mix of factors: adverse reestimates driven by large losses and geopolitical exposures (notably ongoing Russia/Ukraine war uncertainty and CAT losses from the Turkey/Syria earthquakes), reserving for inflationary pressures, and movements in reinsurance recoverables; management commentary also references a net prioryear release (management-reported net release GBP 13.4m) reflecting favourable net claims experience after reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) taken from the Technical Provisions movement line 'Change in prior underwriting year's provisions' (gross = GBP 78,241k). Management narrative also refers to a net prior year reserve release of GBP 13.4m (this is NET of reinsurance) which appears inconsistent with the gross movement; both figures are reported above (gross used for the prior_year_development_gbp_m as requested). Some reserve/release lines (the 'surpluses/(deficits) following reassessment' per LOB) are presented separately and are smaller in magnitude; the report contains both gross and net figures in different places. IBNR/inflation and war estimates cited in the notes are partly expressed net of reinsurance. All monetary amounts outside the claims triangle are converted to millions as requested.
